title: Enable or disable a service on boot
summary: Configure whether a systemd service should start automatically when the system boots. Use enable to add it to startup, and disable to remove it.

steps.explain: Use systemctl with the enable or disable action and the name of the service unit.

placeholders.name: ACTION
placeholders.description: The action to perform: enable or disable.

placeholders.name: UNIT
placeholders.description: The name of the service unit (e.g., nginx.service).

rollback.explain: To undo an enable, use disable. To undo a disable, use enable.

placeholders.name: OPPOSITE_ACTION
placeholders.description: The opposite action: if you enabled it, use disable; if you disabled it, use enable.

placeholders.name: UNIT
placeholders.description: The name of the service unit.

warnings: Disabling a critical system service may prevent the system from booting correctly or functioning properly.
